## Mazapégul (CR 2)

This tiny creature looks like a cross between a primate and a feline. Its ugly, wrinkled face is humanoid, and it grimaces and bares a mouth of small, needle-like fangs.  

**XP** 600  
CE Tiny outsider (chaotic, evil)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvison 60 ft.; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 13, flat-footed 11 (+3 Dex, +1 natural)  
**hp** 33 (3d10+3)  
**Fort** +0, **Ref** +6, **Will** +4  
**DR** 5/cold iron or good; **Immune** electricity, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10, fire 10  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +8 (1d3+3), bite +8 (1d4+3 plus poison)  
**Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Special Attacks** dream invasion, sleep paralysis  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th; concentration +7)  


At will—detect good, detect magic  

1/day—sleep (DC 13), suggestion (DC 15, can only be cast on a sleeping target; the spell takes effect once the creature awakens)  

1/week—nightmare  



**Statistics**


**Str** 8, **Dex** 16, **Con** 13, **Int** 11, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +4; **CMD** 12  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse  
*House rules: Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +9, Bluff +8, Intimidate +8, Knowledge (nature) +6, Perception +7, Stealth +13  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common, Sylvan  


**Special Abilities**



**Dream Invasion (Su)** The mazapégul climbs upon an unconscious creature with the humanoid type, entering its space, and inserts its mind into their dreams, feasting on the psychic energy of its victim. Each round, the mazapégul heals 2d4 hit points. If the mazapégul is not injured, it gains temporary hit points instead, to a maximum of 10. Once the mazapégul has enacted this ability, it can maintain the effects on subsequent rounds as a swift action. The dream invasion ends if the mazapégul leaves the space the humanoid is in, whether voluntarily or involuntarily. When a humanoid affected by this ability awakens, it takes 1d4 mental damage and is fatigued.  

**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; save Fort DC 12; frequency 1/minute for 60 minutes; effect sleep for 1 minute; cure 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Sleep Paralysis (Su)** If the victim of the mazapégul’s dream invasion ability awakens, the mazapégul can use a free action to meet their gaze, if both the mazapégul and the victim can see each other. The victim must succeed at a DC 13 Will save or be paralyzed 1 for 1 minute. While a creature is paralyzed 1 in this manner, the mazapégul can use its dream invasion ability on them as if they were unconscious. The save DC is Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** rural areas near humanoid settlements  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or clan (3-6)  
**Treasure** standard
